id: title:Gilbert09:retry a 409 conflict from the sheets api instead of failing the sync

review.posthog_relevance: Google Sheets warehouse ingestion reliability: the backend now treats HTTP 409 concurrency conflicts alongside quota and server errors as transient, allowing the ingestion worker to retry rather than immediately fail, potentially recovering from temporary API contention.
review.reason: Adds HTTP 409 status code and its string representation to the set of transient, retryable Google Sheets API errors, and updates unit tests. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for the warehouse ingestion workflow, distinguishing transient 409s from permanent failures.
review.uncertainty: The actual recovery benefit and production impact depend on the frequency of 409 errors and the robustness of the retry mechanism, which are not demonstrated by this hunk alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader implementation and validation, not just this hunk.
